messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Kannada, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check. Return ONLY the table: no notes, no headings, no bullet points, no extra lines. Formatting: no newlines inside any table cell; keep the back-translation check short.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |------------|----------------------|--------------------| | Ahi | Exclamatory expression of emotion | Interjection “ಅಯ್ಯೋ” placed clause‑initial; no inflection; Back‑trans: Ah! | | quanto | Marks degree of difficulty of telling | Degree adverb “ಎಷ್ಟು” modifying infinitival clause; requires degree complement; Back‑trans: how | | a | Introduces infinitive “to” | Post‑position “ಗೆ” marking infinitival complement; Back‑trans: to | | dir | Act of stating or describing | Verb root “ಹೇಳು” in infinitive form “ಹೇಳಲು”; Back‑trans: tell | | qual | Introduces content of statement | Interrogative adjective “ಯಾವ” modifying copula; Back‑trans: what | | era | Past state of the referent | Past tense copula “ಇತ್ತು” agreeing with subject; Back‑trans: was | | è | Present state of the “thing” | Present tense copula “ಇದೆ” linking subject and predicate; Back‑trans: is | | cosa | Abstract entity being described | Noun “ವಸ್ತು” in nominative; Back‑trans: thing | | dura | Property of the “thing” (hard/difficult) | Predicate adjective “ಕಷ್ಟಕರ” agreeing with noun; Back‑trans: hard | | esta | Points to a specific forest | Demonstrative adjective “ಈ” preceding noun; Back‑trans: this | | selva | The physical environment (forest) | Noun “ಕಾಡು” in nominative; Back‑trans: wood/forest | | selvaggia | Describes untamed nature | Adjective “ಕಾಡು” (wild) agreeing with noun; Back‑trans: wild | | e | Joins adjectives | Coordinating conjunction “ಮತ್ತು”; Back‑trans: and | | aspra | Describes texture (rough) | Adjective “ಕಠಿಣ” agreeing with noun; Back‑trans: rough | | e | Joins adjectives | Coordinating conjunction “ಮತ್ತು”; Back‑trans: and | | forte | Describes thickness/strength | Adjective “ದೃಢ” agreeing with noun; Back‑trans: dense/strong | | che | Refers back to forest | Relative pronoun “ಅದು” introducing relative clause; Back‑trans: which | | nel | Locates mental space (in the) | Post‑position “ನಲ್ಲಿ” with definite article “ಆ” → “ಆ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ”; Back‑trans: in the | | pensier | The mental arena where effect occurs | Noun “ಮನಸ್ಸು” in locative case; Back‑trans: thought | | rinova | Causes fear to re‑appear | Verb “ಪುನಃ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡು” in present third‑person singular; Back‑trans: renews | | la | Specifies the fear | Definite article not overt in Kannada; use demonstrative “ಆ” before noun; Back‑trans: the | | paura | Emotional response being renewed | Noun “ಭಯ” in accusative; Back‑trans: fear |

### Step 3: Lexical Inventory & Syntactic Assembly Task: For each source line, list ALL required lexical items from Step 2, then assemble into Kannada. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Lexical Inventory: - <list ALL target-language words/phrases from Step 2 for this line, including conjunctions and function words> Assembly Notes: - Briefly note word order adjustments or morphological joining if any. Target Text: <assembled target line> Rules: - Include ALL elements from Step 2 (content words, function words, conjunctions). Missing elements cause coverage failures. - No new content words beyond Step 2 inventory. - Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. - Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous.

Source Line: Ahi quanto a dir qual era è cosa dura Lexical Inventory: - ಅಯ್ಯೋ - ಎಷ್ಟು - ಗೆ - ಹೇಳಲು - ಯಾವಿತ್ತು - ಇದೆ - ವಸ್ತು - ಕಷ್ಟಕರ Assembly Notes: - Kannada places the degree adverb before the adjective; the infinitival marker “ಗೆ” precedes the infinitive “ಹೇಳಲು”; the copula “ಇದೆ” follows the subject noun phrase. Target Text: ಅಯ್ಯೋ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕಷ್ಟಕರ ವಸ್ತು ಇದೆ ಗೆ ಹೇಳಲು ಯಾವಿತ್ತು
Source Line: esta selva selvaggia e aspra e forte Lexical Inventory: - ಈ - ಕಾಡು - ಕಾಡು - ಮತ್ತು - ಕಠಿಣ - ಮತ್ತು - ದೃಢ Assembly Notes: - Demonstrative “ಈ” precedes the noun; the first “ಕಾಡು” functions as the adjective “wild”, the second as the noun “forest”; conjunctions “ಮತ್ತು” link the adjectives. Target Text: ಈ ಕಾಡು ಕಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಕಠಿಣ ಮತ್ತು ದೃಢ
Source Line: che nel pensier rinova la paura! Lexical Inventory: - ಅದು - ಆ - ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ - ಮನಸ್ಸು - ಪುನಃ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡು - ಆ - ಭಯ Assembly Notes: - Relative pronoun “ಅದು” starts the clause; locative phrase “ಆ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ” follows; the verb phrase uses “ಪುನಃ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡು” with the object “ಆ ಭಯ”. Target Text: ಅದು ಆ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಪುನಃ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡು ಆ ಭಯ!

### Step 4: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step3 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Meaning Drift includes wrong modifier attachment/scope. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 4, Target Text: ಅಯ್ಯೋ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕಷ್ಟಕರ ವಸ್ತು ಇದೆ ಗೆ ಹೇಳಲು ಯಾವಿತ್ತು, Back-Translation: “Ah! how difficult a thing it is to tell what was”, Reference Translation: “Ah! how hard a thing it is to tell what”, Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK>, Corrected Target Text: ಅಯ್ಯೋ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕಷ್ಟಕರ ವಸ್ತು ಇದೆ ಗೆ ಹೇಳಲು ಯಾವುದು ಇತ್ತು
- Line 5, Target Text: ಈ ಕಾಡು ಕಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಕಠಿಣ ಮತ್ತು ದೃಢ, Back-Translation: “this forest wild and rough and strong”, Reference Translation: “this wild and rough and dense wood”, Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK>
- Line 6, Target Text: ಅದು ಆ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಪುನಃ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡು ಆ ಭಯ!, Back-Translation: “that in the mind mind renews the fear”, Reference Translation: “which in thought renews the fear!”, Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK>, Corrected Target Text: ಅದು ಆ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಯವನ್ನು ಪುನಃ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡು!
``` ಅಯ್ಯೋ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕಷ್ಟಕರ ವಸ್ತು ಇದೆ ಗೆ ಹೇಳಲು ಯಾವುದು ಇತ್ತು ಈ ಕಾಡು ಕಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಕಠಿಣ ಮತ್ತು ದೃಢ ಅದು ಆ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಯವನ್ನು ಪುನಃ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡು! ```
